G2650.d: κατα-μένω ; [in LXX for יָשַׁב (Num.20:1, al.), etc. ;] ; to remain permanently, abide: Act.1:13, 1Co.16:6, WH (παραμ-, T, EV).†; (AS)

G2674.d: κατ-αριθμέω, -ῶ ; [in LXX: 2Ch.31:19 (יָחַשׂ hith.), al. ;] ; to number or count among: before ἐν, Act.1:1.†; (AS)

G2681.d: κατα-σκηνόω, -ῶ ; [in LXX chiefly for סָכַךְ ;] ; to pitch one's tent, lodge, dwell: before ἐν, Mat.13:32, Luk.13:19; ὑπό, with accusative, Mrk.4:32; ἐπ᾽ ἐλπιδι, Act.2:26 (LXX).†; (AS)

G2660.d: κατα-νύσσω ; [in LXX: Gen.34:7 (עָצַב hith.), Lev.10:3, Psa.4:4, Psa 29:12, al. (דָּמַם), Dan LXX TH Sus 1:10 (רָדַם ni.), Sir.12:12 14:1, al. ;] ; __1. to strike or prick violently. ; __2. to stun. ; __3. Of strong emotion, pass., to be smitten: τὴν καρδίαν, Act.2:37 (see: κατάνυξις).†; (AS)

G2605.d: κατ-αγγέλλω ; [in LXX: Pro.17:5 A, 2Ma.8:36 2Mac 9:17 * ;] ; __1. to pro­claim, declare: with accusative of thing(s), Act.3:24 16:21 17:23; τ. ἀνάστασιν, Act.4:2; τ. λόγον τοῦ Θ., τ. Κ., Act.13:5 15:36; ὁδὸν σωτηρίας, Act.16:17; φῶς, Act.26:23; τ. μυστήριον τοῦ Θ., 1Co.2:1; τ. εὐαγγέλιον, 1Co.9:14; τ. θάνατον τοῦ Κ., 1Co.11:26; pass., ἄφεσις, Act.13:33; ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θ., Act.17:13; ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν, Rom.1:8; with accusative of person(s), of Christ, ὅν, Act.17:3, Col.1:28; τ. Χριστόν, Php.1:17; pass., Php.1:18. ; __2. to denounce (Xen., al.); (for comparison with ἀγγέλλω, ἀναγ-, ἀπαγ-, see Westc. on 1Jn.1:5; and cf. προ-καταγγέλλω).†; (AS)

G2638.d: κατα-λαμβάνω ; [in LXX for נָשַׂג hi., לָכַד, etc. ;] ; __1. to lap hold of, seize, appropriate: Mrk.9:18; with accusative of thing(s), 1Co.9:24, Php.3:12-13 ; __2. to overtake: as carrel, of διώκω (Field, Notes, 158 f.), Rom.9:30; ἡ ἡμέρα, 1Th.5:4; of evils, Jhn.1:5 12:35 (cf. 617 T); hence, to surprise, discover: Jhn.8:3-4], ; __3. Of mental action, to apprehend, comprehend; so mid., in NT (M, Pr., 158): Eph.3:18; before ὅτι, Act.4:13 10:34; with accusative and inf., Act.25:25 (MM, Exp., xv).†; (AS)

G2647.d: κατα-λύω ; [in LXX for לוּן, שָׁבַת, etc. ;] ; __1. to destroy, cast down: Mat.24:2, Mrk.13:2, Luk.21:6; τ. ναόν, Mat.26:61 27:40, Mrk.14:58 15:29, Act.6:14; οἰκίαν, 2Co.5:1; opposite to οἰκοδομεῖν, Gal.2:18. Metaphorical, to overthrow, annul, abrogate: Act.5:38-39; τ. ἔργον τ. θεοῦ, Rom.14:20; τ. νόμον, Mat.5:17 (2Ma.2:22). ; __2. to unloose, unyoke (e.g. horses), hence intrans., of travellers (cf. κατάλυμα), to take up one's quarters, lodge (cl., Gen.19:2, al.): Luk.9:12 19:7.†; (AS)

G2661.d: κατ-αξιόω, -ῶ ; [in LXX: 2Ma.13:12, 3Ma.3:21 3Mac 4:11, 4Ma.18:3 * ;] ; to deem worthy: with accusative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), 2Th.1:5; pass. before inf., Luk.20:35, Act.5:41.†; (AS)

G2641.d: κατα-λείπω ; [in LXX chiefly far שָׁאַר, ni., hi., also for עָזַב, יָתַר, etc. ;] ; __1 1, to leave behind, leave: with accusative of person(s) (of thing(s)), Mat.4:13, Mrk.12:19, 21, Luk.20:31, Act.24:27 25:14, Heb.11:27; of sailing by a place, Act.21:3; ptcp., καταλιπών, redundant (Dalman, Words, 21 f.), Mat.16:4 21:17; pass., Jhn.8:9, 1Th.3:1; metaphorically, εὐθεῖαν ὁδόν, 2Pe.2:15. ; __2. to forsake, abandon: Mat.19:5, Mrk.10:7" (LXX) Mrk.14:52, Luk.5:28 15:4, Act.6:2, Eph.5:31" (LXX) . ; __3. to leave remaining, reserve: with accusative and inf., Luk.10:40; ἐμαυτῷ, Rom.11:4 (LXX); pass., Heb.4:1 (cf. ἐν-κατα-λείπω).†; (AS)

G2697.d: κατά-σχεσις, -εως, ἡ; (κατέχω), [in LXX nearly always for אֲחֻזָּה ] ; __1. a holding back. ; __2. LXX and NT, a holding fast, possession: Act.7:5, 45.†; (AS)

G2686.d: κατα-σοφίζομαι ; [in LXX: Exo.1:10 (חָכָם hith.), Jdth.5:11 10:19 * ;] ; to deal craftily with, outwit: Act.7:19 (LXX) †; (AS)

G2669.d: κατα-πονέω, -ῶ ; [in LXX: 2Ma.8:2 (A), 3Ma.2:2 3Mac 2:13 * ;] ; to wear down, oppress, treat hardly: pass., Act.7:24, 2Pe.2:7.†; (AS)

G2657.d: κατα-νοέω, -ῶ ; [in LXX for נָבַט hi., רָאָה, etc. ;] ; to take note of, perceive, consider carefully: Act.7:31-32; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.7:3, Luk.6:41 12:24, 27 20:23, Act.11:6 27:39, Rom.4:19; with accusative of person(s), Heb.3:1 10:24, Jas.1:23-24 (on the distinction bet. κ. and νοέω simplex, see M, Pr., 117).†; (AS)

G2663.d: κατά-παυσις, -εως, ἡ; (καταπαύω), [in LXX chiefly for מְנוּחָה, Psa.95:11, Isa.66:1, al.; ἡμέρα τῆς κ., 2Ma.15:1] ; __1. in cl., a putting to rest, causing to cease. ; __2. In LXX and NT, rest, repose: Act.7:49 (LXX), Heb.3:11, 18 4:1, 3 4:5, 10-11†; (AS)

G2609.d: κατ-άγω ; [in LXX chiefly for יָרַד hi. ;] ; to bring down: with accusative of person(s), Act.22:30, Rom.10:6; id. before εἰς, Act.9:30 23:15, 20 23:28; as nautical term, to bring to land: τ. πλοῖον ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, Luk.5:11; pass., before εἰς, Act.27:3 2:12.†; (AS)

G2621.d: κατά-κειμαι ; [in LXX: Pro.6:9 23:34 (שָׁכַב), Jdth.13:15, Wis.17:7 * ;] ; __1. to lie down. ; __2. to lie sick: Mrk.1:30 2:4, Jhn.5:6, Act.28:8; before ἐπί with genitive, Act.9:33; id. with accusative, Luk.5:25; ἐν, Jhn.5:3. ; __3. to recline at meals (cf. ἀνάιειμαι): Mrk.14:3, Luk.5:29; before ἐν, Mrk.2:15, Luk.7:37, 1Co.8:10.†; (AS)

G2616.d: κατα-δυναστεύω ; [in LXX for יָנָה, עָשַׁק, etc. ;] ; to exercise power over, oppress: with accusative of person(s) (Xen.; LXX, Mic.2:2, Wis.2:10, al.); with genitive of person(s), Jas.2:6 (ὑμᾶς, T); pass., Act.10:38 (cf. MM, Exp., xv).†; (AS)

G2678.d: κατα-σείω ; [in LXX: Da TH Bel 1:14 AR, 1Ma.6:38 * ;] ; __1. to shake down. ; __2. Of the hand, to shake or wave as a signal: τ. χεῖρα, Act.19:33; τ. χειρί, Act.13:16; id. with dative of person(s), Act.21:40; before inf., Act.12:17.†; (AS)

G2624.d: κατα-κληρονομέω, -ῶ ; [in LXX for נָחַל, יָרַשׁ, etc. ;] ; __1. to distribute by lot or as an inheritance (Num.34:18, Jos.14:1, al.): Act.13:19. ; __2. to receive by inheritance (Deu.1:38, al.).†; κατα-κληροδοτέω, ῶ, ; [in LXX: Deu.1:38 21:16 A (-νομέω, B), (נָחַל), 1Ma.3:36 א R (-νομέω, A)* ;] ; Act.13:19, Rec., = -νομέω, which see†; (AS)

G2664.d: κατα-παύω ; [in LXX for נוּחַ, שָׁבַת, etc. ;] ; __1. trans., ; __(a) to cause to cease, restrain: Act.14:18; ; __(b) to cause to rest: Heb.4:8. ; __2. Intrans., to rest: before ἀτό, Heb.4:4 (LXX), Heb.4:10.†; (AS)

G2679.d: κατα-σκάπτω ; [in LXX for נָתַץ, הָרַס, etc. ;] ; to dig down: Rom.11:3 (LXX).†; (AS)

G2658.d: κατ-αντάω, -ῶ ; [in LXX: 2Ki.3:29 (חוּל), 2Ma.4:21 2Mac 4:24 2Mac 4:44 2Mac 6:14 * ;] ; to come to, arrive at: before εἰς, with accusative loc., Act.16:1 18:19, 24 21:7 25:13 (see M, Pr., 132) Act.27:12 28:13; before ἀντικρύ, with genitive, Act.20:15. G2604.d: καταγγελεύς, -έως, ὁ ; a proclaimer, herald (in Inscr., κ. ἀγώνων, Deiss., LAE, 97): with genitive obj., Act.17:18.†; (AS)

G2618.d: κατα-καίω ; [in LXX chiefly for שָׂרַף; in Exo.3:2 (אָכַל pu.), distinguished from καίω ;] ; to burn up, burn completely: with accusative of thing(s), Mat.13:30 Act.19:19; pass., 1Co.3:15, Heb.13:11, 2Pe.3:10, Rev.8:7; before πυρί Mat.3:12 13:40, Luk.3:17 (cf. Exo.29:14, al.); ἐν πυρί (Deu.9:21, al.): Rev.17:16 18:8.†; (AS)

G2687.d: κατα-στέλλω ; [in LXX: 2Ma.4:31, 3Ma.6:1 * ;] ; __1. to let down, lower. ; __2. to keep down, restrain: with accusative, Act.19:35-36 †; (AS)

G2644.d: κατ-αλλάσσω; (Att.. -ττω; cf. ἀλλάσσω) [in LXX: Jer.48:39 (חָתַת), 2Ma.1:5 2Mac 7:33 2Mac 8:29 * ;] ; prop., to change, exchange (esp. of money); hence, of persons, to change from emnity to friendship, to reconcile (for exx. in cl., see Thayer„ LS): of the reconciliation of man to God (Lft., Notes, 288; ICC on Ro, l.with; DCG, ii, 474, 797), 2Co.5:18-19; pass Rom.5:10, 2Co.5:20; of a woman returning to her husband, 1Co.7:11 (cf. ἀπο-καταλλάσσω).†; (AS)

G2643.d: κατ-αλλαγή, -ῆς, ἡ ; (καταλλάσσω), [in LXX: Isa.9:5(4), 2Ma.5:20 * ;] ; __1. exchange. ; __2. reconciliation: Rom.5:11; κ. κόσμου, Rom.11:15; διακονία τῆς κ., 2Co.5:18; λόγος τῆς κ., 2Co.5:19.†; (AS)

G2631.d: κατά-κριμα, -τος, τό; (κατακρίνω), ; penalty (RV, condemnation; but cf. Deiss., BS, 264 f.; MM, Exp., xv): Rom.5:16, 18 8:1.†; (AS)

G2659.d: κατά-νυξις, -εως, ἡ; (κατανύσσω, which see), [in LXX: Psa.60:3 (תַּרְעֵלָה), Isa.29:10 (תַּרְדֵּמָה)* ;] ; __1. a pricking. ; __2. (Perhaps through resembl. of κατανύσσω to -νυστάζω), torpor of mind, stupefaction: Rom.11:8 (LXX) (see ICC, in l; Field, Notes, 157).†; (AS)

G2620.d: κατα-καυχάομαι, -ῶμαι ; [in LXX: Zec.10:12 (הָלַךְ hith.), Jer.50:11 (עָלַז), Jer.50:38 (הָלַל)* ;] ; __1. to boast against, exult over: with genitive, Rom.11:18, Jas.2:13; before κατά, with genitive, Jas.3:14 (T, om. κατά). ; __2. before ἐν, to glory in (Za., l.with, Jer.27:38).†; (AS)

G2672.d: κατ-αράομαι, -ώμαι depon. ; (κατάρα), [in LXX chiefly for קָלַל pi. ;] ; to curse: with accusative, Mrk.11:21; opposite to εὐλογέω, Luk.6:26, Rom.12:14, Jas.3:9; pass. pf. ptcp., accursed, under a curse (see M, Pr., 221): Mat.25:41.†; (AS)

G2693.d: κατα-στρώννυμι ; [in LXX: Num.14:16 (שָׁחַט), Job.12:23 (שָׁטַח), שָׁטַח), Jdt.4.1-15; Jdt.2.1-28 Mac.4 ;] ; __1. to strew or spread over. ; __2. to lay low, overthrow: 1Co.10:5.†; (AS)

G2666.d: κατα-πίνω ; [in LXX chiefly for בָּלַע ;] ; __1. to drink down, swallow: Mat.23:24, Rev.12:16. ; __2. to devour: 1Pe.5:8. Metaphorical, to swallow up, consume: pass., 1Co.15:54 (LXX), 2Co.2:7 5:4, Heb.11:29.†; (AS)

G2633.d: κατά-κρισις, -εως, ἡ; (κατακρίνω), ; condemnation: 2Co.3:9 7:3 (cf. Deiss., LAE, 91 f.).†; (AS)

G2655.d: κατα-ναρκάω, -ῶ; (ναρκάω, to grow numb, in LXX, in causal sense, for יָקַע, Gen.32:25 (26); without Heb. equiv., Gen.32:32 (33) Job.33:19, Dan LXX 11:6*); ; __1. to cause to grow numb. ; __2. Intrans., to grow numb; hence metaphorically, to be inactive, be burdensome to with genitive, 2Co.11:9 12:13-14; pass., to be quite numb (Hippocr.).†; (AS)

G2615.d: κατα-δουλόω, -ῶ ; [in LXX chiefly for עָבַד ;] ; to enslave: 2Co.11:20, Gal.2:4.†; (AS)

G2636.d: κατα-λαλιά, -ᾶς, ἡ; (κατάλαλος), [in LXX: Wis.1:11 * ;] ; evil-speaking, railing: p1., 2Co.12:20, 1Pe.2:1.†; (AS)

G2676.d: κατ-άρτισις, -εως, ἡ; (καταρτίζω), ; a strengthening, making fit: in ethical sense, 2Co.13:9.†; (AS)

G2684.d: κατα-σκοπέω, -ῶ ; [in LXX: 4Ki.10:3, 1Ch.19:3 (רָגַל pi.), 1Ma.5:38 (A)* ;] ; to view closely, inspect, spy out: with accusative, Gal.2:4.†; (AS)

G2607.d: κατα-γινώσκω; (see: γινώσκω), [in LXX: Deu.25:1 (רָשַׁע hi.), Pro.28:11 (חָקַר), Sir.14:2 19:5 * ;] ; to blame, condemn: with genitive of person(s), 1Jn.3:20-21; pass., κατεγνωσμένος ἦν (RV, he stood condemned, see Ellie., in l; but cf. Field, Notes, 188): Gal.2:11.†; (AS)

G2689.d: κατα-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ; (καταστέλλω), [in LXX: Isa.61:3 (מַעֲטֶה)* ;] ; __1. a letting down, checking. ; __2. steadiness, quietness in demeanour. ; __3. LXX and NT (cf. Plut., ii, 65 D; -ίζω = vestire), a garment, dress, attire: 1Ti.2:9 (but see Ellic., in l).†; (AS)
